ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 85% low-intensity (black) surface area vs. 15% high-intensity (white) localized regions at the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary black field (low intensity) across 90% of the central fluke. Distinct high-intensity white patches at the distal tips; the right lobe contains a concentrated white field (approx. 10% of lobe area) with nested circular black voids. The left lobe exhibits more sparse, fragmented white mottling at the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped median notch; approximate pixel-angle of 155 degrees; depth-to-width ratio is low.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; small-amplitude pixel variations (valleys and peaks) are more frequent and jagged on the left lobe compared to the right lobe's smoother trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; initial convexity near the median notch transitioning into pronounced concavity towards the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible circular/ovoid high-contrast white rings and clusters distributed across the central black field; densest cluster of circular spots observed within the white distal patch of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct diagonal white linear marks visible in the lower-central dark field; one approximately 15 pixels in length, oriented at a roughly 45-degree angle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Rough-textured, yellowish-brown calcified clusters (barnacles) visible at the extreme distal corners of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'leopard-print' pattern of dark circular pixels nested within the high-intensity white region of the right distal lobe tip.
